name: Opportunities for All (OFA) and Black 2 San Francisco
org: San Francisco Human Rights Commission, with JCYC
what_you_do: Paid summer internships with local organizations and businesses, plus career workshops and mentorship. Black 2 San Francisco is a separate 6 week program for 30 students.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 24 who live in or go to school in San Francisco (that is the only rule on the OFA page).
pay_detail: Paid; the hourly rate and hours are not posted on the pages read
duration: B2SF is 6 weeks; OFA length not stated on the pages read
deadline_text: The 2026 OFA deadline was April 10, 2026. The summer application is closed; 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the JCYC Workhub, complete the application and submit before the spring deadline.
notes: Applications are run by JCYC. B2SF and the OFA fellowships share an application with other youth programs. Interest areas decide placement.
